Oracle Technical Lead

Center of Excellence | Working alongside Tessera AI Agents

Location: US-based.

Remote: Yes, within the US, with travel to customer and partner sites as needed.

Experience: 15+ years

Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

Positions: 1

Reports to: Head of Center of Excellence

Start date: Immediate.

Engagement model: Capability and Oracle Technical leadership role. Approximately 30%

building and leading the Oracle technical team, 55% technical architecture and AI-enabled

delivery across several concurrent customer engagements, and 15% pre-sales technical

solutioning. Works US business hours with a distributed team across the US and India.

About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers

governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years

to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, Salesforce,

Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera combines the reliability of an integrator with the

speed of an AI-native platform.

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations

have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and

business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for

Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile

in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a

coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and

lets teams work in plain English.
